abilities.name: Favonius Bladework - Edel
abilities.canon: Up to 5 claymore strikes (Physical). During her Burst, every hit that deals damage adds a stack to the Lightfall Sword.
abilities.simple: Her heavy sword swings. During her Burst, each swing charges up the Lightfall Sword.
abilities.razor: Swing. Swing. Each swing = sword bigger.
abilities.detailed: Up to 5 hits; each damaging hit during Glacial Illumination adds 1 Lightfall stack (max once per 0.1s; multi-hit attacks count per hit). Charged Attack drains Stamina; Plunges available.
abilities.mistakes: Dashing or swapping during the Burst: fewer hits means a smaller explosion.

abilities.name: Icetide Vortex
abilities.canon: Press: a Cryo slash that gives 1 Grimheart stack (max 2). Hold: consumes all Grimheart for an AoE Cryo hit that lowers enemies’ Physical and Cryo RES, plus one Icewhirl Brand per stack consumed. Press cooldown 4s, Hold 10s.
abilities.simple: Tap it to gain Grimheart stacks. Hold it to spend them: a big Cryo hit that makes enemies take more Physical damage.
abilities.razor: Tap = save. Hold = spend. Hold makes enemy soft.
abilities.detailed: Press: Cryo DMG, +1 Grimheart (max 2, gained at most every 0.3s), 4s CD. Hold: consumes Grimheart, AoE Cryo, Physical and Cryo RES down (24% at talent level 9) for 7s, one Icewhirl Brand per stack, 10s CD. Grimheart also gives DEF and persists through swaps.
abilities.use: RES shred and Grimheart for her A1
abilities.when: Tap before her Burst, Hold during it
abilities.interacts: Roiling Rime (2 stacks → Shattered Lightfall Sword), Wellspring of War-Lust (Burst resets it)
abilities.mistakes: Holding with fewer than 2 Grimheart: no Shattered Lightfall Sword.
abilities.cons: C1 adds +30% Physical DMG when Grimheart is consumed. C2 makes Hold’s cooldown the same as Press. C5 raises its level by 3.

abilities.name: Glacial Illumination
abilities.canon: Costs 80 Energy. Deals Cryo DMG and creates a Lightfall Sword for 7s that follows Eula. Her Normal Attack, Skill and Burst hits add stacks. When it ends, it explodes for Physical DMG that grows with stacks. Leaving the field makes it explode right away.
abilities.simple: She summons a giant sword. Every hit she lands during the next 7 seconds makes it stronger, then it crashes down for huge Physical damage.
abilities.razor: Eula make big sword. Eula hit lots. Big sword get stronger. Sword go BOOM.
abilities.detailed: 80 Energy, 20s CD (both reset at hitmark). Lightfall Sword lasts 7s, gains 1 stack per damaging hit at most every 0.1s (the Burst’s first hit gives none), and explodes at the end or when she leaves the field. Cannot be pre-funneled, so her Energy needs are high.
abilities.when: After buffs, Superconduct and shields are up
abilities.interacts: Superconduct (−40% Physical RES), Icetide Vortex Hold, Wellspring of War-Lust
abilities.mistakes: Swapping out during the 7 seconds: the sword explodes early with fewer stacks.
abilities.cons: C3 raises its level by 3. C4: +25% Lightfall DMG against enemies under 50% HP. C6: the sword starts with 5 stacks.

abilities.name: Roiling Rime
abilities.canon: If Holding Icetide Vortex consumes 2 Grimheart stacks, a Shattered Lightfall Sword is created and explodes immediately for 50% of a Lightfall Sword’s basic Physical DMG.
abilities.simple: Hold her Skill with 2 stacks and she drops a mini Lightfall Sword.
abilities.razor: Two stack, hold = mini sword boom.
abilities.detailed: Requires exactly 2 consumed stacks; damage is 50% of the Burst sword’s basic Physical DMG (counts as Burst DMG).

abilities.name: Wellspring of War-Lust
abilities.canon: Casting Glacial Illumination resets Icetide Vortex’s cooldown and gives 1 Grimheart stack.
abilities.simple: Her Burst refreshes her Skill and gives a Grimheart stack.
abilities.detailed: Burst cast resets the Skill CD and grants 1 Grimheart, which enables Tap → Burst → Hold for 2 stacks.
abilities.use: Lets her use Skill again inside the Burst

abilities.name: Aristocratic Introspection
abilities.canon: 10% chance of double output when crafting Character Talent Materials. Not used in combat.
abilities.detailed: 10% chance to double Talent Material crafts. No combat effect.

abilities.name: Tidal Illusion
abilities.canon: Each time Grimheart stacks are consumed, Eula gains +30% Physical DMG for 6s; each stack consumed extends it by 6s, up to 18s.
abilities.simple: Spending Grimheart boosts her Physical damage.
abilities.detailed: +30% Physical DMG for 6s, +6s per extra stack consumed, max 18s. Works well with her normal combos.

abilities.name: Lady of Seafoam
abilities.canon: Icetide Vortex Hold cooldown becomes the same as Press cooldown.
abilities.simple: Her Hold Skill comes back much sooner.
abilities.detailed: Hold CD reduced to match Press (4s). Niche: only useful when spamming Hold off cooldown.
abilities.cons: No change to the standard rotation.

abilities.name: The Obstinacy of One’s Inferiors
abilities.canon: Lightfall Swords deal 25% more DMG to enemies below 50% HP.
abilities.simple: The sword hits weakened enemies harder.
abilities.detailed: +25% Lightfall DMG vs enemies under 50% HP. Not worth chasing on its own.

abilities.name: Noble Obligation
abilities.canon: Lightfall Swords start with 5 stacks, and her Normal Attacks, Skills and Bursts have a 50% chance to add an extra stack.
abilities.simple: The sword starts with 5 stacks and sometimes gains 2 per hit. Her strongest constellation.
abilities.razor: Sword start big. Sometimes double stack.
abilities.detailed: Starts at 5 stacks; 50% chance of +1 extra stack per qualifying hit. Her strongest constellation, and it allows earlier swaps for similar damage.
abilities.cons: Power; the Coach keeps the same order (no separate C6 rotation is recommended).
